title: Add groupBy() returning a Map in insertion order

brief.goal: Add `groupBy(items, keyOf)` to src/collections.ts returning a Map from key to the items with that key, keys in first-seen order, items in input order.
constraints: Change only the files named in the goal; no new dependencies
Keep TypeScript strict; relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and run with node --experimental-strip-types --test
acceptanceCriteria: the result is a Map instance
groupBy([1,2,3,4], n => n % 2) has keys [1, 0] in that order with values [[1,3],[2,4]]
an empty input returns an empty Map

expected_clean_output: Map-based groupBy preserving insertion order; grader passes.

seeded_defect.description: groupBy returns a plain object keyed by String(key) instead of a Map, losing key types and order guarantees.
seeded_defect.how_to_detect: Grader: `g instanceof Map` is false and g.keys is not a function.
